observations: All four original point formulas and strict closest(a, summary) owner identity comparisons are retained; no retry-until-hit or permissive geometry substitute is added.
Both selected mobile enhanced navigation owners must now report data-site-link-enhanced=true, using the same bounded 20-second expectation already used on desktop.
No-js remains independent; minimum 44 px heights and matching group/leaf radii remain asserted.

The actual wheel is sent by page.mouse.wheel after native hover. A document capture listener records actual isTrusted, composedPath membership of leaf and nearest real scroll owner, deltaY, and starting/expected clamped scrollTop.
The wheel must make a nonzero actual scroll change, reach the clamped observed target within 1 px, and retain it through two requestAnimationFrame turns before the original hit observations.
The public visibility controller explicitly yields to user wheel/touch/pointer/key input. The fixture does not edit that controller, its CSS, its state, or its scrollTop.
The listener and JSHandle are disposed in finally. Failure JSON includes the same-evaluation point observations; screenshot timing is explicitly after that observation.
Static diff inspection found only this fixture modified at review time.
limitations: This review did not execute product tests, native browser tests, a build, or any GitHub write.
manualScrollRetained describes only the measured two-rAF window, not an indefinite timing guarantee.
Original diagnostic proves offscreen owner geometry and missing enhancement at the observation, not the identity of the exact scroll writer.
Require the original 7/20 target failures to remain preserved, same-source repaired fixture repetition results, and a final clean-source 42-site/304-case validation before Ready.
